column1: # partitions.csv — Stage-0 spike (4 MB). Two OTA slots (no factory) so a real OTA partition-flip +
# rollback can be exercised; the app boots from ota_0. An nvs partition holds the injected
# creds/boot_epoch; a coredump partition makes a real panic produce a resolvable ELF backtrace.
# Sizes are chosen to fit EXACTLY in 4 MB (0x400000) — matches the L2 supervisor's flash.bin.
